tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i rjes 'brang bka' gdams kyi byung tshul legs par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ bka' gdams kyi byung tshul legs par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan a ti sha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor lo'i mgon po rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs gcen bsod nams dbang po dang / gcung grags pa blo gros/ mched/ /rje btsun mus pa'i rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ zhabs dang spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub/ bar/ /btud de thub pa'i/ dbang po'i/ rgyal tshab dam par gyur pa/ bka' gdams pa'i/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi/ /byung tshul legs par bshad pa/ nyung gsal kun dga' 'dir spel lo/ /shes bya kun mkhyen gnyis med spyod pa mdzad/ /'dod lhas rjes bzung mngon shes lnga dang ldan/ /byang chub sems gnyis kyi rtogs pa dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i stobs/ kyis rgya bod kyi/ 'gro ba 'dul bar/ mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan mar me mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ jo bo rje la rgya gar na slob ma dbu lta bu/ bo dhi pa spyan lta bu/ ratna kā ra sa'i thugs lta bu/ snying po/ dang / /phyag g.yas pa lta bu/ bshes gnyen phyag g.yon lta bu/ gsang ba dbu ma 'di la dharma a ka ra ma ti zhes zer ro/ /seng ge lnga/ /nyid dang mkhyen pa mnyam yang byin rlabs mi mnyam/ pa'i bu chen yin/ /lha btsun pa/ /byang chub 'od dang lo tsā rnam pa lo chen rin bzang / nag tsho tshul khrims rgyal ba/ rma dge blo/ gsum/ /mnga' ris yul gyi slob ma chen por grags/ /ling lo tsā ba/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ rong pa/ mgar dge ba/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ se ston sgra gcan 'dzin/ bzang gzhon nu 'bar/ la sogs pa/ /gtsang gi phyogs su byung ba'i bu chen yin/

/dbus kyi khu khu ston g.yung drung brtson 'grus/ rngog rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu btab/ 'brom gsum po rim pa bzhin phyag rdor/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs su grags/ slob ma'i mchog /lho brag tu byung ba'i/ slob ma chag khri mchog blo gros 'bar dang 'di mkha' spyod byon/ dge btsun pa/ skyong gnyis/ khams pa /phyag dar ston pa rnal 'byor rnam pa 'di'i ṭikka la phar phyin khams lugs su grags pa yin/ gsum/ ni rnal 'byor pa chen po lung a mi byang chub/ dgon pa 'dzi bsgom dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje 'di la gsang phur sku yal zer/ 'di gsum dang chag khri mchog bzhi la jo bo'i rnal 'byor pa bzhi zer/ /khams kyi yul du byung ba'i slob mar grags/ /sgrol mas lung bstan jo bo la slob ma mang du yod kyang 'brom la byin rlabs kyi/ bka' babs pas na jo bo'i/ thugs kyi sras/ dam pa yin no/ /'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ kyis ra sgreng btab nas slob ma'i mchog /sku mched gsum ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa phu chung pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ phyag rdor sprul pa spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa po to rin gsal rnams/ dang khams lung pa sgang ston shākya yon tan 'di rngog lo'i bla ma yin/ sogs byon/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rgyal sras po to bas/ /bka' gdams gzhung drug la sogs bshad sgrub kyis/ /bstan pa rin chen phyogs bcur gsal mdzad skyes rabs ched du brjod pa'i tshom/ tshom dad pa'i gzhung / /sa byang pa/ rgyan mdo sde rgyan/ rin chen ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung / /spyod btus spyod 'jug bslab bsdus/ spyod pa'i gzhung / bka' gdams zer ba'i sgra bo che de khong gi drin las byung ba yin gsungs/

phyir/ /brgyud par bcas la bka' gdams gzhung par grags/ /de sras chos kyi spyan ldan sha ra ba/ yon tan grags 'di la zhang rong po yang zer/ /byams dang thugs rje'i mnga' bdag glang thang pa/ rdo rje seng ge 'di sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul par grags/ /rnam gnyis nyi zla lta bu'i thugs sras yin/ /gzhan yang thugs sras brgyad du grags pa ni/ /gtsang gi ram sdings ma ba 'byung gnas rdo rje/ snang gro lhas pa g.yor gyi 'be mon bu chung ba/ rog lo pa shes rab rgya mtsho/ gnyis/ /snyal gyi glang bya ra ba dang / snyos gra gor ba gnyis/ dbus ru'i bya 'phreng ba/ brag dkar ba/ gnyis/ /rog dmar zhur ba/ gi be bum sngon po zhes bya ba po to ba'i gsung la zin bris mdzad pa 'di la don steng pa dang lha 'bri sgang la sogs kyis 'grel pa mdzad do/ /dang / /grab pa gzhon nu 'od 'di la pho brang sdings pa yang zer/ kyi dpe chos rin spungs pa po to ba'i gsung la zin bris su/ mdzad/ /brag dkar bas rgyas su btang 'khrugs bsdebs/ gce sgom snar thang mkhan po dpal ldan/ gro shes rab rdo rjes yang rgyas su btang 'grel pa bzang po mdzad do/ mo che pa bdud rtsi'i grags kyi dpe chos kyi 'grel pa mdzad 'di mchim nam mkha' grags kyi bla ma yin no/ /yis/ /dpe chos 'khrugs sdebs cung zad rgyas par mdzad/ /rnam dpyod mtshungs med sha ra'i ba 'di la tshe 'di blos btang ba'i grwa pa sum stong brgyad brgya byung bar grags/ bu bzhi ni/ byang sems kyi bka' babs/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ man ngag gi bka' babs/ stabs ka ba dang gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs/ 'od 'jo ba/ dar ma grags kyis ra sgreng gi gdan sa mdzad do/ /longs spyod kyi bka' babs /rnal 'byor shes rab rdo rje 'di la shes rab pa phyi ma yang zer/

zhes byar grags/ /gtum ston 'di sha ra ba'i slob mar grags/ blo gros grags kyis snar thang btab/ brtseg nyi ma 'dul 'dzin bu chen du 'dod/ /rgya ston lcags ri ba dang zhang zhung pa/ /mdo sde la sogs glang ri thang pa'i sras/ /dol dmar zhur ba/ pa'i slob ma don steng pa sogs yin/ /khu nu'u ba 'di'i bka' gdams thams cad rten 'brel gyi khrid du bsdus nas gsungs/ yis sgrub pa nyag gcig pa la/ rtsal du ston/ 'di la slob ma med zer ba mi 'thad de dge bshes/ /pha bong kha pa zhes bya'i slob ma byon/ par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /spyan snga ba yis lo yi dgon pa btab/ nas bka' gdams thams cad bden bzhis khrid du bsdus nas gsungs/ /mkhas pa chen po /stod lung pa rin chen snying po/ de'i dbon po/ dang bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ la sogs/ khong nas spyan snga'i sgom pa rnam bzhi 'don/ /slob ma mang byon bya yul ba yi sras/ /gyer sgom dang byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dwags po lha rje/ la sogs chen po bcu gsum byon/ /de'i sras rgya ma sangs rgyas dbon ston gzhon nu 'byung gnas 'dis rin chen sgang btab pa/ yin/ /spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar/ nas bzung ba'i brgyud pa rnams kyi bshad sgrub gnyis kyi nang nas/ sgrub pa gtsor mdzad pa'i/ phyir/ /spyan snga bka' brgyud la /bka' gdams gdam ngag pa zhes bod 'dir/ grags pa yin/ par 'dug gsungs/ /rnal 'byor che lung a mi byang chub kyi/ sras mang ra brtson 'grus 'bar dang / 'di la snyug rum pa yang zer/ mtha' bzhi gnyis/ brtson 'grus 'bar/ /snga ma'i snyug rum pa/ slob ma mnyam med/ dwags po lha rje bsod nams rin chen/ sogs/ byon/ /dgon pa'i slob ma ka ma pa shes rab 'od zer/

sne'u zur ba ye shes 'bar/ gnyis/ sne'u zur pa 'di /phyi ma mi g.yo sngon po'i grub thob 'di nas brgyud pa'i mi g.yo ba'i chos drug yod/ yin/ nag tsho'i lo tsā ba slob ma rong pa phyag sor ba/ 'dis jo bo'i dngos slob brgyad dang / nying slob gnyis te bcu thug lag sor dgon par bzhugs/ /brgyud par bcas la bka' gdams 'og mar grags/ shing nag tsho bka' brgyud kyang zer/ /bya 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus 'bar 'dis zul phu btab/ zhu ldan pa sna 'bar ba 'di stod lung rgya dmar ba byang chub grags dang gcig go /rog stag brtan pa/ snga mo dus su/ rma tsho'i bu bzhi nyid du grags dus phyis rong pa la dad nas chos zhus pas/ rong pa'i bu bzhir grags/ bu mo gcig ni rgya gar ston gyi yin dge bsnyen yin pas bu mor bgrang / /bya 'dul dang dpal chen rdor gzhon dang 'chad ka ba gsum ka'i/ slob ma rnal 'byor byang seng sogs/ /seṅge'i mtha' can bzhi ru grags pa rtsis pa gzhon seng / rje mo chos seng / ka ba ston seng zer/ yang gcung po rin chen skyabs dang / khams pa rdor rgyal dang / gtsang nag pa la sogs pa mang du/ byon/ /sha pho sgang pa padma byang chub/ sku mched gsum ka'i sras/ yin no/ /jo bo'i dngos slob yer pa'i zhang btsun 'ol rgod pa ye shes 'bar yang zer po to ba'i bla ma yin/ dang / /dgon pa ba'i 'dzing sgom byang chub rgyal mtshan dang / sba sgom bsod nams ye shes gnyis ka sras kha rag sgom chung dang / rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ /po to'i slob ma 'ban sgom gung rgyal ni mi skya'i ming yin chos ming tshul khrims rgyal ba/ sogs/ khong nas brag rgyab kyi gnyan ston shāka 'byung sogs 'don/ /sgrub la brtson pa'i dam pa mang du byon/ /de ltar bstan dang 'gro ba'i rtsa lag snyan/

mchog /'brel tshad don ldan skyes chen bzang rim par byon pa/ de dag las/ /rim par brgyud pa bar ma chad pa/ 'ong ba'i gzhung dang gdam ngag sogs/ zab la rgya che ba'i chos tshul/ bsam las 'das pa zhig yod/ kyang de dag gi nang nas/ rags rim tsam/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan slob mar bcas pa/ dang / /rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga rin chen kun dga' don 'grub/ las/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis thos/ /zhes bka' gdams bla ma brgyud pa'i byung tshul legs par bshad pa nyung gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rnams kyi zhabs sen spyi bos len pa/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis shar mi nyag gi paṇḍi ta grags pa rdo rje'i gsung rab la gzhi byas te bka' gdams pa'i chos dang gang zag rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa chen po'i ngang nas/ byi lo zla ba bcu pa'i dmar cha'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang gi yang rtser sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis pa'o/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub nas/ /bstan pa rin chen mchog tu 'phel ba dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i rjes 'brang bka' gdams kyi byung tshul legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
